Name: Hashabiah, Father of Azrikam
Summary: Father of Azrikam the Levite, of the sons of Merari.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:14: Father of Azrikam the Levite, of the sons of Merari.
LifeLesson: The mention of Hashabiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
